subject: Contract edits: who does what before signature
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@acmehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Contract edits: who does what before signature

Thanks for the productive demo this morning — quick recap and a proposed handoff for the legal milestone so we keep to the target close date.

Recap (short):
- Acme liked the dedicated throughput and the SLA language we demoed.
- Procurement and legal will lead redline review.
- Next tangible milestone: finalize MSA/DPA/SLA redlines and sign.

Attached: first draft MAP with milestone table and suggested owners. Please review the ownership and turnaround targets and propose any changes by EOD Monday.

Key asks from today:
- Acme: share primary legal contact and any non-negotiable contract clauses (security, data residency, indemnity).
- Redwood: provide committed turnaround times for redline reviews and a single point of contact for legal syncs.

Proposed legal milestone (from the MAP draft):
- Task: Exchange redlines on MSA/DPA/SLA
  - Owner (Customer): Tom Alvarez / Acme Legal
  - Owner (Redwood): Priyom Das (Legal lead)
  - Initial turnaround (first-pass): Customer: 72 hours; Redwood: 48 hours
  - Final turnaround (post-discussion): both parties 24–48 hours depending on scope
  - Dependency: Acme to confirm any non-standard security addendum items (see attached questionnaire)
  - Target close for signature: 2026-12-03 (aiming for end of quarter)

I left Ben on the thread to own commercial points (pricing, term language). Priyom will coordinate the legal exchange and consolidate redlines in a single file to avoid multiple parallel threads.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: Acme_MAP_v0.2.docx] (contains milestone table and proposed dates)
- [Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf] (security checklist we discussed)

Next steps:
1) Tom or Susan — confirm you have a primary legal contact and if the 72h initial pass works for you.
2) If ok, Priyom will propose a cadence (30–45 minute legal sync) for next week to walk any sticking points.
3) Ben & I will prepare a short commercial anchor to limit rework during redlines (pricing/term anchors).

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: Acme_MAP_v0.2.docx]
[Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]

From: Susan Park <susan.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract edits: who does what before signature

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear doc.

Quick responses:
- Confirmed legal lead: Tom Alvarez (cc'd). He prefers redlines consolidated into one document and a single thread for commercial vs legal, so this format is helpful.
- 72h initial pass is acceptable but our internal procurement will try to do a preliminary quick pass within 48 hours for low-risk items; for substantive legal changes expect the 72h window to be realistic.

Attached a first-pass redline on the MSA (minor items + a few SLA clarifications).

A couple of notes from our side:
- Data residency: we will surface whether we need a EU-only residency clause by next Wednesday.
- Indemnity cap: procurement may propose a higher cap than the draft — Ben, please confirm your flexibility range so we can flag early.

We can do a 30-minute legal sync next Wednesday (11/25) at 10am PT. Tom, does that work for you?

Thanks,
Susan
Director of Procurement, Acme Health
susan.park@acmehealth.com
[Attachment: Acme_MSA_redline_v1.docx]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@acmehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract edits: who does what before signature

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 9:14 AM Susan Park <susan.park@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear doc.
> 
> Quick responses:
> - Confirmed legal lead: Tom Alvarez (cc'd). He prefers redlines consolidated into one document and a single thread for commercial vs legal, so this format is helpful.
> - 72h initial pass is acceptable but our internal procurement will try to do a preliminary quick pass within 48 hours for low-risk items; for substantive legal changes expect the 72h window to be realistic.

Thanks — good alignment. I updated the MAP to reflect the hybrid turnaround you described and tightened the owners/contacts. Summary of commitments below (please treat as proposed and reply with changes):

Updated legal milestone commitments (proposed, from Redwood):
- Initial exchange: Acme shares redlines (Tom) -> Redwood consolidates within 24 hours of receipt and returns a single consolidated redline set (Priyom) within 48 hours.
- Commercial comments: Ben to review pricing/term asks and provide commercial anchor within 24 hours of receiving Acme's procurement list.
- Finalization: after two pass cycles, both parties commit to 24–48 hour turnarounds for final sign-off.
- Synchronization: propose one 30-minute legal sync (11/25 @ 10:00am PT) to triage big-ticket items; Priyom to lead on Redwood side.
- Target signature window: 2026-12-01 through 2026-12-03. If both parties adhere to the turnaround targets above, we should hit it.

Attachments updated: consolidated MAP with milestone and a combined redline container so we avoid multiple parallel files.

[Attachment: Acme_MAP_v0.2_consolidated.docx]

DocuSign and HubSpot: I've added the planned close date in HubSpot and created a placeholder DocuSign envelope (link below). When we have final redlines, I'll route to DocuSign and request signatures.
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/ACME-2026-092
- DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.example/sign/placeholder-id

Please reply if the timing doesn't work or if someone else should own any of the items above. Otherwise we'll treat this as the working plan and proceed.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Acme_MAP_v0.2_consolidated.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract edits: who does what before signature

Internal note — keeping this short:
- I will own commercial anchors (pricing, term length, auto-renew language). Plan to respond within 24 hours of seeing Acme's procurement list.
- Priyom: please confirm Redwood Legal can do the first consolidated redline within 48 hours of receiving Tom's file and the second pass within 24–48 hours once we've discussed. If legal needs more time for any clause (indemnity/data residency), call it out early and we'll escalate.
- Monica: I'll coordinate with you on the DocuSign cadence once we have final redlines.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
